{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Check if any converted order is refunded
# If converted == 1 and status == 'refunded', that's inconsistent
inconsistent = sales_df[(sales_df['converted'] == 1) & (sales_df['status'] == 'refunded')]
print("Number of inconsistent records (converted=1, status=refunded):", len(inconsistent))

# Also check if any completed order is not converted
not_converted_completed = sales_df[(sales_df['converted'] == 0) & (sales_df['status'] == 'completed')]
print("Number of inconsistent records (converted=0, status=completed):", len(not_converted_completed))"}
